sources.title: qwq-plus model information (indexed October 10, 2026 version)
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27: the exact English model URL redirects to the general model-selection page; the Chinese counterpart does likewise. The previously indexed page documents Qwen2.5 family lineage and capabilities but no total/active parameter count or named size-bearing base. Historical capability assessments below are preserved.

sources.title: Model lifecycle and updates
sources.evidence: Freshly reopened release table lists qwq-plus on 2025-03-05 in both regional sections. It calls it an enhanced QwQ reasoning model trained on Qwen2.5 with reinforcement learning, but does not name a Qwen2.5 size or equate it with QwQ-32B. No structural change or parameter count is specified.

sources.title: Qwen3 Technical Report
sources.evidence: Freshly reopened Tables 13 and 15 explicitly label QwQ-32B as Dense with nominal 32B total and 32B activated parameters. These are valid published nominal counts for that named model, but the report does not name QwQ-Plus or provide a named-model relation that would support transferring them.

sources.title: Qwen/QwQ-32B model card
sources.evidence: Freshly reopened developer card publishes 32.5B total parameters and 31.0B non-embedding parameters for QwQ-32B; the latter is not an activated count. It names Qwen2.5-32B as the base in model metadata, but contains no QwQ-Plus relationship. This establishes the released model specification, not the size of every QwQ family member.

sources.title: QwenLM/QwQ
sources.evidence: Freshly reopened current README identifies QwQ-32B as the released model and its hosted example uses model="qwq-32b". The initial March 11 README was also checked separately; neither names qwq-plus. Family membership alone does not identify the Plus base.

sources.title: Notice on the Postponed Retirement of Selected Legacy Models
sources.evidence: July 6, 2026 primary notice explicitly includes qwq-plus among legacy mainline models scheduled to cease service October 10, 2026, subject to actual change time. This establishes the announced retirement, not a successful API availability test.

sources.title: Qwen3-235B-A22B-Thinking-2507 model card
sources.evidence: Freshly reopened July 2025 reasoning-model card and searched its comparison material: no QwQ or QwQ-Plus entry supplies an additional total/active disclosure or named-base relationship.

sources.title: QwQ-32B launch post, original March 5 source commit
sources.evidence: Original launch source and current published post both describe QwQ-32B as nominally 32B and give model="qwq-32b" in the DashScope example under Use QwQ-32B. The original Chinese post was also checked and contains no qwq-plus mapping. The release describes reinforcement learning, not a disclosed Plus-specific structural variant.

sources.title: QwQ initial README, March 11, 2025
sources.evidence: The earliest repository README names QwQ-32B in the introduction and local model loader, and uses model="qwq-32b" in its API example. The two subsequent March 11 README revisions also contain no qwq-plus. The proposed historical-README identity lead did not establish a Plus relationship.

sources.title: QwQ-32B first model-card README, March 5, 2025
sources.evidence: Checked the first model-card README and all eleven README-related revisions listed by the official Hugging Face history through March 10. None names qwq-plus or supplies an API example mapping that identifier to this checkpoint.

sources.title: QwQ Plus API description
sources.evidence: Secondary reseller lead claims a 32.5B QwQ-32B-based production variant, but supplies no cited developer evidence for that relationship. Rechecking original Qwen launch material, repository and model-card history did not corroborate it; the claim is not adopted as a verified model specification.

name.note: Readable display form of the exact official identifier qwq-plus.

developer.note: QwQ is developed by Alibaba Cloud's Qwen team.

family.note: Official release description places the model in the Qwen QwQ series.

release_date.note: Explicit release-table date for qwq-plus in both regional sections.

open_weights.note: No exact first-party closed-weights declaration or mapping to a released checkpoint was verified. API availability alone cannot establish false; the QwQ-32B release cannot establish true.

license.note: No model-weight license was verified for this exact endpoint. QwQ-32B's Apache-2.0 license is not transferable without an identity mapping.

parameters_b.note: Fresh primary-source and launch-history search found Qwen2.5 family lineage only, without a size-bearing named base or direct Plus count. QwQ-32B has valid published nominal 32/32.5B totals, but neither the original launch API example nor historical READMEs map Plus to it. The uncited reseller 32.5B claim remains uncorroborated.

active_parameters_b.note: Qwen3 Tables 13 and 15 separately publish nominal 32B activated parameters for QwQ-32B. No primary QwQ-Plus identity or named-base relationship was found to transfer that count; the Plus sources disclose no activated count.

architecture.note: Qwen2.5 derivation is documented, but it does not identify the exact base checkpoint or establish dense versus MoE for this hosted variant.

context_window.note: Exact token limit in the complete indexed primary model page; last documented before its redirect.

modalities.note: Both regional capability tables document text input and output.

reasoning.note: Release table explicitly classifies the exact model as reasoning.

tool_call.note: Supported in Beijing; unsupported in Singapore. True records documented model capability with this regional qualification.

description.value: Qwen reasoning model for deliberate problem solving, math, and coding
description.note: Faithful concise characterization; no unsupported parameter, architecture or performance-ranking claim.

patch.notes: QwQ-Plus has documented Qwen2.5 family lineage but no verified size-bearing base relation; total and active parameter counts remain undisclosed. QwQ-32B counts are not transferable from the available primary evidence. Weight openness and architecture remain unresolved. Function Calling was documented for Beijing but not Singapore. Context and modalities are last-documented values from the October 10, 2026 page, which now redirects. Alibaba announced October 10, 2026 retirement; current operation was not tested.

Original QwQ-32B launch source: API example names qwq-32b
Initial QwQ README: no Plus identity mapping

summary: Fresh October 27 parameter re-audit leaves total and active counts undisclosed. Reopened exact-model documentation, release chronology, Qwen3 Tables 13/15 and later card; checked original English/Chinese QwQ launch sources plus repository and model-card history. QwQ-32B publishes nominal 32.5B total and later 32B active, but launch-era API examples name qwq-32b, not qwq-plus. Qwen2.5 family-only lineage and an uncited reseller mapping do not support a count inference. Other audited fields are preserved.
